paite: Huan nipikal a ani masapen, phalvak in, gimnamtui abawlte uh tawi in, han ah ava hoh uhi.
heading: Jesu Thohnawnna / (Mat 28.1-10; Mar 16.1-8; Joh 20.1-10)

paite: Han a kipan suangtum khuksuan a om amu uhi.
Huan alut ua, Toupa Jesu luang amu kei uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, huaiziak a amangbat lai un, ngai in, mi nih puan milengthei silh akiang uah ahong dingh uhi.
Alau ziak ua, lei si a bokkhup a a-om lai un, akiang uah, "Bangziak a misi lak a mihing zong?
Hiai ah a-om nawnta kei, athounawnta; Galili gam a a-om lai a na kiang ua athugen theigige un,
Mihing Tapa mikhialte khut ah matsak in a-om ding a, akilhden ding ua, ani thum ni in athounawn ding ahi, achih," achi uhi.
Huan athugente ahon thei thak nawn uhi.
Hanmun a kipan apai nawn un, sawm-le-khatte leh midang tengtengte kiang ah huai thil tengteng ahilh uhi.
Sawltakte kiang a huai thuhilhte bel Mari Magdalin, Mari, Joanna, Jakob nu Mari leh akiang ua numei dangte ahi uhi.
Himahleh huaite thugen thu maimai in angai ua, amau ataksang kei uhi.
Himahleh Peter athou a, han ah ataita a; huan akun a, a-en a, puanmalngat omte kia amu a, huchi in thil omdan lamdang satak in inn lam ah apaita hi.
Huan ngai in, huai ni mah in alak ua mi nih khua khat Emmaus achih uah ahoh dek ua, huai khua Jerusalem a pan ching sawmguk ahi.
heading: Emmau Lampi A Jesu Kilakna / (Mar 16.12-13)

paite: Huan thil hong tung tengteng agenkhawm zel uhi.
Gen a akisel lai un, Jesu ngei in ahon zuan a, akiang uah apai samta hi.
Himahleh amah a theihlouhna ding un, amit uh hihvaih in a-om hi.
Huan akiang uah, "Pai kawm a na genkhawm uh bang thu ahia?” achi hi. Huan dahmeltak in adingh dinden uhi.
Huan amin Kleopas pen in akiang ah, "Tulai a thil omdan na theih louh, Jerusalem ah nangmah kia in hia na ten?" chi in adong hi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Bang thil eita?" achi hi. Amau akiang ah, "Nazaret Jesu, Pathian leh mi tengteng mitmuh a athu leh athilhih a zawlnei minthangtak tanchin thu;
siampu liante leh ka heutute un thah ding a thu apiak ua, akilhden thute uh.
Kou amah zaw Israelte tanpa hi ding a lamen lua hi ung a, himahleh, huai thiltun nungsiah tuni ani thum ni ahita hi.
Huai lou leng ka pawlte uh numei kuate hiam zingsang in, han ah ava hoh ua, hon hihmangbang uhi.
Aluang muloupi in, Pathian angelte kilak ka mu uh, huai mite'n athounawnta chih agen uh, ahong chi uhi.
Ka ompihte lak ua kuate hiam han ah ahoh ua, numeite gen bang ngei in amu ua; himahleh amah amu kei uh," achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Mihaite aw, zawlneite thugen tengteng gintak thu a ze-olte aw;
Khrist in huai thilte thuak a thupina a lut ding him ahi kei a hia?" achi hi.
Mosi leh zawlneite tengteng a pan in, Laisiangthou tengteng a ama tanchin toh kisai peuhmah amau ahilhchian zel hi.
Huan ahohna ding khua uh atung dekta ua; amah gamla deuh a hoh tum bang in a-om hi.
Kam in akhou ua, "Ka kiang uah taam in; nitaklam hi ding ahita a, ni leng tum dekta ahi," chi in. Huchi in akiang ua taam ding in alutta hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, akiang ua an um a atut in tanghou ala a, avualzawl a, abalkham a, akiang uah apia hi.
Huan amit uh ahong vakta a, amel atheichianta uhi. Himahleh amah amangta mai hi.
Amau, “Lampi a hon houpih lai a Laisiangthou thute hon hilhchet lai in i lungtang avakhuai him hilou hia?" akichi uhi.
Huai laitak in, athou ua, Jerusalem ah akik nawn ua, sawm-le-khatte leh alawm omkhawmte amu ua, amau,
"Toupa ana thounawn taktak ahi, Simon kiang ah leng akilakta," ana chi uhi.
Amau lampi a bang thil om hiam chih leh tanghou abalkhap a, amel atheihdante uh ahilh sam uhi.
Huai thu agen lai un, Jesu mahmah alak uah ahong dingh a, akiang uah, "Na tung uah khamuanna om hen," achi hi.
heading: Nungzuite Kiang Ah Jesu Akilak / (Mat 28.16-20; Mar 16.14-18; Joh 20.19-23; Nas 1.6-8)

paite: Himahleh kiguih hial in, lauhuai asa mahmah ua, sikha mu hi in akingaihtuah uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Bang achia mangbang na hi ua? Bangziak a na lungsim ua ginlahna hong om ahia?
Ka khutte ka khepekte en un, kei mahmah ka hi. Hon khoih unla, thei un; sa leh guh nei a na hon muh bang un, kha in zaw sa leh guh anei ngal kei hi," achi hi.
Huai agen khit in akhutte akhepekte amau alak hi.
Kipah luat ziak a agin ngam louh ua lamdang asak lai un, akiang uah, "Hiai ah banghiam nek ding na nei uhia?" achi hi.
Ngahou, bak khat leh khuaizu khak apia uhi.
Ala a, ama uah aneta hi.
Huan akiang uah, "Na kiang ua ka om lai a ka tanchin gelh peuhmah thute ahong tung ding chi a ka hon hilhhilhte Mosi Dan, zawlneite leh phatna late a thu kigen, hiaite mah ka thu ahi,” achi hi.
Huchi in Laisiangthou thu theihna ding in alungtang uh avaksakta hi.
Huan akiang uah, "Hichibang a gelh ahi, Khrist in gim athuak ding a, ani thum ni in misi lak a kipan athounawn ding,” achi hi.
"Ama min in kisikna leh khelh ngaihdamna thu Jerusalem khua a pan in nam chih kiang ah hilh ahi ding," chi in.
"Huai thil tengteng atheihpihte na hi uhi.
Huan ngai un, na tung uah ka Pa thuchiam ka hon sawl ding hi. Himahleh, tunglam a kipan thilhihtheihna silhsak a na om masiah uh khopi ah om kinken un," achi hi.
Huan Bethani pha in amau apikhia a; huan aban azak a, avualzawl hi.
heading: Jesu Thu Nanung Leh Vankahna / (Mar 16.19-20; Nas 1.9-11)

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, avualzawl laitak in amau apaisan a, van ah pitouh in a-omta hi.
Huan amah abia ua, kipak kawm in Jerusalem ah akik nawn ua;
tempul ah Pathian phat in a-om nilouh uhi. Amen.
